description: Save the scannable barcode images from an accesso order. Writes PNGs and returns their paths; set inline to receive the images directly instead (which is the only useful mode when this server runs remotely, since its filesystem is not the user's).

indexes.description: Ticket `index` values to act on. Omit for every ticket on the order.

inline.description: Return the images in the response instead of writing files.

url.description: The accesso ticket link from the order-confirmation email. Optional when ACCESSO_TICKET_URL is set.

name: accesso_save_barcodes
